page.description: Manage and configure chat bot personality settings

form.customErrorMessageHelp: When this persona's LLM request fails (for example, connection failures), this error reply is sent first. Leave empty to use the default error message.
form.presetDialogsHelp: Add some preset dialogs to help the bot better understand the role settings. The number of dialogs must be even (users and assistants take turns).
form.toolsHelp: By default, this persona can use all currently enabled builtin tools. In specific-tool mode, it can only use selected tools that are also globally enabled; selecting none disables all function tools.
form.skillsHelp: Select available Skills for this persona. Skills provide reusable workflows and guidance.
form.skillsRuntimeNoneWarning: Computer Use runtime is set to None; Skills may not run correctly because no runtime is enabled.

memory.description: This text is sent to the AI as durable background whenever the persona is active, but it cannot override the system prompt or current request. During administrator conversations, the AI may save stable preferences, durable facts, and explicit remember requests.
memory.fieldHint: Use short declarative facts. Do not store passwords, API keys, temporary task progress, or short-lived information.
memory.autoSaveHint: Automatic AI updates are available only for administrator messages.
